mapper.select: with tmp_date_1 as ( select distinct date from t_index_raw t where t.stockCode = '1.000001' order by 1 desc limit 1 ) , tmp_date_2 as ( select distinct date from t_index_raw t where t.stockCode = '1.000001' order by 1 desc limit 1 offset 1 ) , tmp_rank_1 as ( select tene.`date` , tene.chg , tene.volume , rank() over (partition by tene.date order by tene.chg desc, tene.stockCode ) chg_rank , tene.stockCode , t3.stockName from t_etf_raw tene , t_etf t3, tmp_date_1 t5 where 1 = 1 and tene.`date` = t5.`date` and tene.stockCode = concat(t3.stockType , '.', t3.stockCode ) order by chg_rank, 1 desc ) , tmp_rank_2 as ( select tene.`date` , tene.chg , tene.volume , rank() over (partition by tene.date order by tene.chg desc, tene.stockCode ) chg_rank , tene.stockCode , t3.stockName from t_etf_raw tene , t_etf t3, tmp_date_2 t5 where 1 = 1 and tene.`date` = t5.`date` and tene.stockCode = concat(t3.stockType , '.', t3.stockCode ) order by chg_rank, 1 desc ) select concat(t11.stockCode, '-', t11.stockName) stockCode , t11.`date` date , concat(t11.chg, '-', t11.chg_rank) last , concat(case when t11.chg_rank <= 3 -- 1、当天前三 and t11.chg > 2 -- 2、当天chg>2% and t11.volume BETWEEN t22.volume * 1.25 and t22.volume * 2 -- 3、相较于前一天，成交量放量25%~100% and t22.chg < 2 -- 4、前一天的chg<2% and t22.chg_rank > 3 -- 5、前一天不在前三； then '*got-' else '' end, 'next-vol: ', round(t11.volume * 1.25/10000), 'W ~ ', round(t11.volume * 2/10000), 'W') ratioB from tmp_rank_1 t11, tmp_rank_2 t22 where t11.stockCode = t22.stockCode order by t11.chg_rank

with tmp_res as ( select tene.`date` , lag(tene.date, 1) over (partition by tene.stockCode order by tene.`date` ) date_pre_1 , tene.stockCode , tene.chg , tene.`last` , round(tene.volume/lag(tene.`volume`, 1) over (partition by tene.stockCode order by tene.`date` ) *100, 1) - 100 vol_ratio_1 , lead(tene.`chg`, 1) over (partition by tene.stockCode order by tene.`date` ) chg_next_1 , lead(tene.`chg`, 2) over (partition by tene.stockCode order by tene.`date` ) chg_next_2 , rank() over (partition by tene.date order by tene.chg desc, tene.stockCode ) chg_rank from t_etf_raw tene where date > DATE_FORMAT(DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE() , INTERVAL -60 DAY), '%Y-%m-%d') ) , tmp_target_res as ( select t1.* , GREATEST(chg_next_1, chg_next_1+chg_next_2) great from tmp_res t1 where 1 = 1 and t1.chg_rank <= 3 -- 1、当天前三 and t1.chg > 2 -- 2、当天chg>2% and t1.vol_ratio_1 between 25 and 100 -- 3、相较于前一天，成交量放量25%~100%； and not exists( select 1 from tmp_res t2 where t2.chg < 2 -- 4、前一天的chg<2% and t2.chg_rank <= 3 -- 5、前一天不在前三； and t1.date_pre_1 = t2.`date` and t1.stockCode = t2.stockCode ) ) select concat(t11.stockCode, '-', te.stockName) stockCode , date , concat('chg=', t11.chg) last , concat('后2日, great=' , case when round(great, 1) < 0 then '----' else '' end , round(great, 1), '%' ) ratioB from tmp_target_res t11, t_etf te where 1 = 1 and t11.stockCode = te.fullStockCode order by 2 desc, 1
